5 min per part (once you have the tokens)

The artists {npc:Percybald} (Carlin) and {npc:Alyxo} (Issavi) give you the {wiki:Royal Costume Outfits|Royal Costume Outfits} and their addons in exchange for donations of {item:Silver Token|Silver Tokens} and {item:Gold Token|Gold Tokens}. The full outfit costs 30,000 Silver Tokens and 25,000 Gold Tokens, and your name is added to the {wiki:Memorial|Memorials}.
No Premium or minimum level needed (8 recommended).
Have the tokens needed for each part.
15,000 for the outfit + 7,500 for each addon
12,500 for the outfit + 6,250 for each addon
Your character's name is listed in the {wiki:Memorial|Memorials}
You can talk to either of the two NPCs: {npc:Percybald} in Carlin or {npc:Alyxo} in Issavi. The dialogue is the same.
On each visit you choose one part: {key:armor} (outfit), {key:shield} (addon 1) or {key:crown} (addon 2).
Go to {npc:Percybald} in **Carlin** or {npc:Alyxo} in **Issavi** with **15,000 {item:Silver Token|Silver Tokens}** and **12,500 {item:Gold Token|Gold Tokens}**.
Say {key:hi}, {key:outfit} (or {key:addon}) and {key:yes}. Then say {key:armor} and confirm with {key:yes}.

With **7,500 {item:Silver Token|Silver Tokens}** and **6,250 {item:Gold Token|Gold Tokens}**, say to the NPC {key:hi}, {key:outfit} (or {key:addon}) and {key:yes}. Then say {key:shield} and {key:yes}.

With another **7,500 {item:Silver Token|Silver Tokens}** and **6,250 {item:Gold Token|Gold Tokens}**, say to the NPC {key:hi}, {key:outfit} (or {key:addon}) and {key:yes}. Then say {key:crown} and {key:yes}.
